text.p: Polish automotive group Sobieslaw Zasada Centrum SA plans to issue between 500,000 and five million shares in the second half of this year, the firm's spokesman said on Wednesday.
Marcin Trzaska told Reuters that the firm's shareholders, who approved the issue in June last year, would agree on details at a meeting sometime later this year.
"There are plans for such an issue but along the way there will be a shareholders meeting which can increase or decrease the amount," Marian Trzaska told Reuters. @
Trzaska said the proceeds from the issue would go toward capitalising the firm's subsidiaries including bus-makers Jelcz SA and Autosan SA and lorry-maker Star SA.

He said the firm expected the open-ended contract signed on Monday with Mercedes Benz Polska Sp. z o.o. for Zasada to import, assemble, sell and service Mercedes Benz cars would be worth 250 million marks this year and increase in value in the next few years.
